tableLines.line: SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Sofia.
📓 Codex: Thornfield split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
🧳 A traveler says Thornfield burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Witness. People bring you their suspicions, written down. You keep every one.
◈ THE EMBASSY — the table is set, the bundle is served, and the galaxy ate from it. The deed is done — the seat still waits on the deeds.
◈ THE TABLE — between now and the seat, the world holds its breath. The wild can still take your food — but it cannot take your people.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Pavel speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. Not yet. The table is being set for those whose deeds are done, and yours are not done. The ledger still wants: wave-3 monsters faced. The climb is not over.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
🥣 Tomás of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
📓 Codex: Tomás of The Red Table begs food at Haven's fire.
🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table has bound itself to Ashford. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.
Tomás waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Sofia of The Red Table with 3 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
📓 Codex: Sofia of The Red Table raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.
🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Sofia of The Red Table didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 800 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.
